content.text:
Repaired finding submitted.

**What changed in response to the verifier:** the single replace on p0289 now also strikes clause (b)(ii) — M&I's consent-free right to assign "to any entity which is a successor to the assets or the business of the M&I Data Services division of M&I." That retained divisional/partial-business exception was the reason "Other assignments require consent." was not met; with it deleted, the general consent sentence reaches every non-successor assignment, and (b)(i)'s merger/reorganization/substantially-all-assets carve-out (now on written notice) covers genuine succession to M&I.

**Final fallback coverage:**
- Both parties may assign to a successor — operation 1 (Customer carve-out broadened to any successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, stock or securities).
- A successor assignment requires written notice — operation 1 ("in each case upon written notice to the other party"; "freely" removed so M&I's carve-out is consistent).
- Other assignments require consent — operation 1 (deletion of (b)(ii)).
- Consent not to be unreasonably withheld — already met, retained verbatim.

Section 21.11's cross-reference, the consent standard and Section 21.11.B's change-of-control mechanics are preserved; no dangling references result.
